rubric.role_summary: Founder and CEO to build a US senior-living robotics venture, taking a night-patrol robot from concept through operator pilots, commercialization, fundraising, and company formation.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Founder and CEO to build a US senior-living robotics venture, taking a night-patrol robot from concept through operator pilots, commercialization, fundraising, and company formation.
Explicit disqualifiers:
- A profile limited to traditional senior-living executive experience or pure robotics research is not sought.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Deep familiarity with at least one of US senior-living or CCRC operators, eldercare, or enterprise facilities operations.
- Experience navigating multi-site operator sales cycles and turning pilots into fleet rollouts.
- Experience integrating hardware or robotics products into healthcare and/or medical care.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): United States; New York metropolitan area; Greater Chicago, Illinois area; Greater Austin, Texas area; Greater Houston, Texas area. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Hybrid work is based in one of these areas.

soft_requirements: Comfort operating in ambiguity and making decisions with incomplete data.
